tools.name: olx_search
tools.description: Search offers on OLX.pl, Poland's largest classifieds site, across every category: flats and houses for rent or sale, cars and parts, phones and electronics, furniture, clothes, jobs, services, free items. Filter by words, category, place (city or district, with a radius) or voivodeship, price range

tools.name: olx_offer
tools.description: Full details of one OLX.pl offer: price (or salary for a job), every attribute with its Polish name and value (area, rooms, rent, condition, model, year, mileage…), the full description, all photo URLs, location (city, district, voivodeship, map coordinates — often approximate), seller type and publ

tools.name: olx_categories
tools.description: Find the category_id for olx_search. Without arguments: OLX's 19 top-level categories. With parent_id: that category's sub-categories (instant, from a snapshot of OLX's category tree). With query: which categories the offers matching those words fall in, with live offer counts, largest first — the q
